title: poecilopteris fluviatilis
intro: Poecilopteris fluviatilis, commonly known as the "River fern", is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Poecilopteris fluviatilis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
